messages.instruction: the same rule is being re-enqueued: generators must diff against the registry's content hash before donating, and spend the saved cells on an unvisited grid cell
prefer lower-frequency charts / limit entries: the edge is real often enough to reach the cost gates and is being spent on turnover

messages.trigger: fx x H1 x asia share of intake > 0.4
messages.instruction: the compiler's novelty gate raises the bar for that cell; scouts and engines prefer other cells -- another chart, another session, another asset class
mine mechanisms with a DATED PAYER -- releases, fixings, index and futures rolls, close hedging flow -- which do not need the counterparty to be wrong

messages.trigger: intake rows carrying a point-in-time stamp < 0.9
messages.instruction: every intake row must carry available_time: an unstamped row cannot be judged point-in-time, and a certificate built on one is uncashable

messages.trigger: intake outside the top-3 asset classes < 0.15
messages.instruction: hunt the classes the docket is thin in -- metals, energy, indices, bonds, soft commodities -- a trial spent there costs the same and buys independent breadth

messages.trigger: backlog rose over the window AND exceeds 2.0x the cells judged in it
messages.instruction: READY_PRIORITY only: the exchange serves the top-scored, the rest wait. Generate no less -- order the queue by score and let the tail sit until capacity frees

prior_contract.consumers: the discovery compiler and the moat engines (read-only; nothing here reaches into them)
prior_contract.limitation: the verdict ledger carries no chart, so the chart axis reads the docket's declared default (H1) for every bucket until the gauntlet stamps one. The bucket is real; the chart in its key is the default, and a consumer must not read it as a measurement.

cold.why: a grid cell is COLD until a verdict in it has PASSED. A machine that only generates where it has already succeeded is a fixed point of its own history, so this share is floored, never optimised away.

trial_budget.boundary: a share ORDERS the queue, it never bans a family, lowers a bar or shrinks the build: no family is ever served zero cells

declared.why: seconds of FIRST-TIME cell building one sweep may spend; cached cells are free and are always all loaded

measured.why: cells judged by the LAST sweep: the per-pass capacity the desk actually has

intended_feedback.shape: per-arm worth multiplier from the window's failure mix
intended_feedback.why: the bandit accepts graph rows and returns a posterior; it has no API that RECEIVES an external evidence row, and its only file-shaped inbound worth path is data/research_marginal.json, whose writer is research_pnl.py. Two writers on one artifact is how an artifact goes stale with nobody at fault, so this is published, not written.
intended_feedback.to_wire: either bandit.evidence grows a `feedback_by_arm` argument, or research_pnl folds this report's class shares into worth_by_arm

unmeasured.gate_verdict_ledger.jsonl: TRUNCATED_KEPT_NEWEST(500000 of more; read backwards and stopped at the cap after 500002 lines)

rule: the gauntlet talks back: the miners change what they generate, and every failure class moves a prior, while cold exploration keeps its floor

core.why: every block other than `capacity` and `core.testing_24h` is the last FULL build's, stamped `full_at`, and unchanged; a reader that needs a fresh window must check `full_at`, never `at`
